description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016948339 DOOR,ACCESS,UTILITY: Line 0001 Qty 6 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0067 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
